{{Top|leg}}
A '''simulcast hyperspace beacon''' was a device used during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. It was used to broadcast the results of [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop bike races]], a popular sport at the [[Time/Legends|time]], to multiple [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] instantly.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
